## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A reusable pytest fixture stubs decide/decide_intent and is exercised by at...

The system SHALL ensure that a reusable pytest fixture stubs decide/decide_intent and is exercised by at least one test that asserts the caller's fallback rule still runs when the stub returns None.

#### Scenario: A reusable pytest fixture stubs decide/decide_intent and is exercised by at...

WHEN `add-the-adapter-backed-test-substitute-and-dry-run-policy` is implemented
THEN A reusable pytest fixture stubs decide/decide_intent and is exercised by at least one test that asserts the caller's fallback rule still runs when the stub returns None.

### Requirement: Adapter-backed behavioural tests are skipped by default, run only when the...

The system SHALL ensure that adapter-backed behavioural tests are skipped by default, run only when the adapter env is present, and every such test name contains "uncalibrated".

#### Scenario: Adapter-backed behavioural tests are skipped by default, run only when the...

WHEN `add-the-adapter-backed-test-substitute-and-dry-run-policy` is implemented
THEN Adapter-backed behavioural tests are skipped by default, run only when the adapter env is present, and every such test name contains "uncalibrated".

### Requirement: A test asserts that running any system_one-consuming script with --dry-run...

The system SHALL ensure that a test asserts that running any system_one-consuming script with --dry-run performs zero client constructions.

#### Scenario: A test asserts that running any system_one-consuming script with --dry-run...

WHEN `add-the-adapter-backed-test-substitute-and-dry-run-policy` is implemented
THEN A test asserts that running any system_one-consuming script with --dry-run performs zero client constructions.
